# 高一英语单元测（自检样例）

满分：30分 时间：30分钟

一、单项选择

1. She usually ___ to school by bike. （5分）
A. go B. goes C. going D. gone

2. The book ___ by many students last year. （5分）
A. read B. was read C. is read D. reads

3. I don't know ___ he will come tomorrow. （5分）
A. that B. whether C. what D. which

4. ___ in 2008, the stadium is now a landmark. （5分）
A. Built B. Building C. To build D. Build

5. It is the third time that he ___ the film. （5分）
A. saw B. sees C. has seen D. had seen

6. Hardly ___ the room when the phone rang. （5分）
A. he had entered B. had he entered C. he entered D. did he enter
